title: A sphere obstruction for the Hilbert shift quotient
summary: Let $\mathcal H=\ell^2(\mathbb Z)$ and let $\mathbb Z$ act by bilateral shifts. We prove that the quotient $\mathbb S(\mathcal H)/\mathbb Z$ of the unit sphere, equipped with its quotient metric, has infinite Hilbert distortion. Consequently, $\mathcal H/\mathbb Z$ does not admit a bilipschitz embedding into Hilbert space, answering a question of Cahill, Iverson, and Mixon.
